verdict.rationale: Rive is an editor and runtime platform with MCP, CLI and agent-facing surfaces, so least-privilege credentials for agents is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no API keys, tokens or permission scoping. Probes also find no Rive HTTP API or spec ('Rive has no versioned HTTP API'), so there is no evidence of scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
